title: Martian pylon and vox-array architecture
stage: Local authored candidates and isolated Factorio proof; owner visual approval pending
units: One Blender unit per Factorio tile; Z up; origin at ground-centre
brief: Three distinct sizes each of power pylon and communications array. Both families carry native copper power, red circuit and green circuit wires. Arrays add powered radar-style persistent map vision.
balance_status: Provisional initial tuning, not owner-approved balance
art: Deep Martian red armor, cast gunmetal, ferrocrete foundations, aged brass terminals, ribbed ivory ceramic insulators. Load-bearing gothic ribs, mounted radio aerials and routed services. No imported third-party geometry.
implementation: Visible native electric pole plus lifecycle-linked native radar for arrays. Medium/large radar graphics carry a 64-heading rotating dish and moving shadow; fixed bases carry native copper/red/green terminals. Native electric and circuit networks remain authoritative. No scripted charting or polling scan loop.
dish_motion: Medium and large dishes continuously yaw on a proper thrust bearing; fixed aerials are outside the full sweep. Ten seconds per rotation at full power, stopped without electricity. Source Blend and GLB both include the authored turn animation.
